predictions.articleTitle: Decoupling Rangers vs Falkirk: Expected Goals (xG), Defensive Absences & Match Intelligence
predictions.coreRecommendation: Rangers' superior home chance creation and Falkirk's confirmed defensive and midfield absences point toward a home victory in an open, multi-goal contest.
possibilityAssessment: Home Win: Rangers' 2.50 xG/match attack and 5-of-6 Ibrox win rate target a depleted Falkirk defense missing Strain, Spencer, and McCann (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Over 2.5 Goals & BTTS Yes: A 3.23 combined lambda and Falkirk's six-of-seven away scoring record support 3 to 4 total goals with both sides netting (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)

First-Half Transition Volatility: Falkirk's 63.6% away first-half goal share and Rangers' 91-hour turnaround create early transition risk before Rangers' second-half surge tells (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

spf.comment: Rangers' 2.50 xG output and intact attacking core project a 2:1 or 3:1 home win against a Falkirk defense missing Strain, Spencer, and McCann.
